# Fort Dental

> Fort Dental is a pediatric dentistry and orthodontics practice serving children across Washington with specialized services including braces, oral surgery, and general anesthesia.

Fort Dental operates multiple locations throughout Washington (Tukwila, Burien, Des Moines, Federal Way, Renton, and other areas) with a team of dental specialists led by Dr. Brown. The practice focuses on comprehensive children's dental care, orthodontic treatment, and specialized procedures for pediatric patients.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Orthodontics and braces
- General anesthesia
- Oral surgery
- Child dental care
- Dental specialists
- Preventative care
- Special needs dentistry
- Wisdom teeth extraction
- Teeth alignment
- Insurance accepted
- Tukwila, WA
- Dr. Brown
- SMS appointment reminders
- Dental procedures

## Core Dental Services

- [Children's Dentistry](https://fortdental.net/childrens-dentistry): Pediatric dental care and special needs dentistry services
- [Orthodontics/Braces](https://fortdental.net/orthodontics-braces): Orthodontic braces and teeth alignment services for children
- [Oral Surgery](https://fortdental.net/oral-surgery): Oral surgery and wisdom teeth extraction for pediatric patients
- [General Anesthesia](https://fortdental.net/general-anesthesia): General anesthesia services for pediatric dental procedures at Fort Dental
